3. Confidential Information shall not be reproduced in any form except as required to accomplish the intent of this Agreement.  

TARGET STATEMENT:
The contract entails that the relevant party must keep confidential the existence, terms, subject matter, or status of the agreement, negotiations, discussions, or transaction between the parties.

DECISION TASK:
Determine whether the contract context entails the target statement.

arguments.text: The contract context only restricts the reproduction of "Confidential Information" and does not establish a broad confidentiality obligation over the agreement itself or its terms.
arguments.legal_rule: Contract interpretation requires explicit language to impose confidentiality obligations on the agreement's existence or terms.
arguments.evidence_span: Confidential Information shall not be reproduced in any form except as required to accomplish the intent of this Agreement.

arguments.text: The target statement requires confidentiality of the agreement's existence, terms, subject matter, or status, which are not mentioned or covered by the contract context.
arguments.legal_rule: Entailment in contract NLI requires that all material elements of the target statement be present or logically necessitated by the context.
arguments.evidence_span: existence, terms, subject matter, or status of the agreement, negotiations, discussions, or transaction

arguments.text: Without a contractual definition of "Confidential Information," there is no logical basis to infer that the term encompasses the agreement's terms, negotiations, or transaction status.
arguments.legal_rule: Undefined terms in contracts cannot be expansively interpreted to cover unmentioned subject matter without explicit definition or industry standard.

arguments.text: The explicit exception for reproducing information "as required to accomplish the intent of this Agreement" limits the scope of any confidentiality duty, contradicting the target's broad entailment.
arguments.legal_rule: Carve-outs and exceptions in contractual obligations narrow the scope of the duty and prevent broad entailment.
arguments.evidence_span: except as required to accomplish the intent of this Agreement.

arguments.text: The target statement introduces obligations regarding "negotiations, discussions, or transaction" that are completely absent from the provided contract context.
arguments.legal_rule: Contractual entailment cannot be established for concepts or obligations not present in the source text.
